question: What two findings support the claim that prism latch membranes keep desalination output stable during brine surges?
expected_answer_points: prism latch membranes maintain output flux during brine surges
ion balance remains stable after repeated brine surge cycles

candidate_papers.title: Prism latch membranes under brine surge flux stress
candidate_papers.text: Prism latch membranes maintain desalination output flux during brine surges by holding the pore gates open through the high-salt pulse.

candidate_papers.title: Ion balance stability in prism latch desalination membranes
candidate_papers.text: After repeated brine surge cycles, prism latch desalination membranes preserve ion balance and show no measurable cation drift in the treated output.

candidate_papers.title: Review of prism latch flux tests
candidate_papers.text: This review repeats the prism latch membrane flux terminology but summarizes only single-cycle flux screens and provides no ion balance evidence.

candidate_papers.title: Polymer liners during brine surge cleaning
candidate_papers.text: Polymer liners are cleaned during brine surges in a desalination plant, but the study does not evaluate prism latch membranes or output stability.
